definitions.explanation: A seasoning made by combining vinegar with sugar (and sometimes other ingredients). Used widely in Japanese and Chinese-style cooking for dressings, dipping sauces, and marinades.

examples.japanese: {甘酢|あまず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{漬|つ}ける→漬ける：09861_tsukeru⟧。
⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{甘酢|あまず}{漬|づ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。

⟦{鶏肉|とりにく}→鶏肉：02919_toriniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揚|あ}げて→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧{甘酢|あまず}あん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかず→おかず：08272_okazu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you deep-fry chicken and pour sweet-and-sour sauce over it, it becomes a dish popular even with children.

notes:
USAGE:
{甘酢|あまず} is a compound of ⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧ (sweet) and ⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧ (vinegar). It is a basic seasoning combination in Japanese cooking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {甘酢|あまず}{漬|づ}け (sweet-vinegar pickles)
- {甘酢|あまず}あん (sweet-and-sour thickened sauce)
- {甘酢|あまず}⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧ (sweet-and-sour sauce)
- {甘酢|あまず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (pour sweet vinegar over)

COOKING NOTE:
Basic {甘酢|あまず} is made by dissolving sugar in rice vinegar. Variations include adding soy sauce, dashi, or chili. It is used for ⟦{南蛮漬|なんばんづ}け→南蛮漬け：27594_nanbanzuke⟧ (nanban-style marinated dishes) and ⟦{酢|す}の{物|もの}→酢の物：04982_sunomono⟧ (vinegared dishes).
